description: Yearn's yDAI v1 strategy moved DAI between Curve and Compound using Curve 3pool balances and get_virtual_price as a routing proxy. Attacker flash-loaned ~$116M DAI, imbalanced the 3pool, triggered the strategy at the unfavorable rate, then rebalanced — pocketing the slippage Yearn realized as strategy losses. The flaw is reading a manipulable AMM exchange rate as truth for routing decisions. The exploit pattern repeated across 11 transactions over 38 minutes; exploit_tx is the run() call from exploiter 0x14EC0c… that the official Yearn security disclosure cites as the initial detected attack tx.
